name: JavedAI 12 - Call Analysis and CRM Sync

parameters.content:
## SETUP REQUIRED — shared post-call processor

This workflow is **inactive** and all external writes are disabled. It accepts a normalized final call record from workflows 10/11 or a raw Vapi `end-of-call-report`.

1. Attach an n8n **Header Auth** credential to **Post Call Analysis Webhook** and use the same secret in callers.
2. Keep `llm_enabled`, `crm_enabled`, and `metrics_sink_enabled` false until their URLs and credentials are configured in **Validate Redact and Deduplicate**.
3. If enabling the optional LLM HTTP node, attach a provider-specific Header Auth credential. The prompt requests JSON only; **Safely Parse LLM Result** validates and falls back to deterministic analysis.
4. Attach a HubSpot private-app Header Auth credential (`Authorization: Bearer …`) to both HubSpot nodes. Create or remap these contact properties first: `javedai_last_call_outcome`, `javedai_last_call_summary`, `javedai_last_call_at`, `javedai_last_vapi_call_id`.
5. HubSpot contact update uses `PATCH /crm/v3/objects/contacts/{contactId}`. Note creation uses `POST /crm/v3/objects/notes` and the HubSpot-defined note-to-contact association type 202.
6. The workflow redacts email addresses, phone-like strings and payment-card-like digit runs, limits transcript size, never stores recording URLs, and keeps only a bounded sanitized audit. Review consent and retention before production.
7. Static workflow data supplies basic idempotency. Use a transactional database/queue when running concurrent workers.

Official HubSpot references: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/crm/contacts and https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/crm/notes
